correctness.rationale: The odd-dimensional classification follows from a known six-step Coxeter-polynomial recurrence plus a direct eigenspace computation that detects the unique size-two Jordan block at eigenvalue 1 in residues 9 and 11 modulo 12. The even-dimensional formula follows from the known derived-equivalent tensor-product model and an exact eigenvalue-order argument. Finite exact symbolic checks agree with every stated formula.

originality.rationale: Qualified to the best of our knowledge. A 2020 open question asks for exactly this periodicity classification for fixed truncation exponent, while the directly relevant older literature establishes cyclotomicity and the recurrence but not the r=3 finite-order classification or exact periods. Targeted searches through current literature found no equivalent statement; an inaccessible older full text leaves a documented residual risk.

value.rationale: The theorem completely resolves the r=3 case of an explicit Coxeter-periodicity problem, gives exact periods in every periodic case, and identifies a precise Jordan obstruction showing why cyclotomicity need not imply finite order.
